contents: The same tournament as its /matches sibling, in the other vocabulary: uuid not id, timeOfSeries not scheduledAt, shorthand not shortName. Carries isLive and isCompleted, which /matches lacks entirely.

verification.verbatim: elements are verbatim; truncated from 2 stages to 1 and from 24 matches to 3

pairedWith: bounty-2026-season-2_matches.json — the two are the same matches and must be diffable, which is why both were captured in the same minute.
